_note: A SECOND PACK, DECLARED AS PURE DATA. This folder exists to prove that a pack can contribute prompt material without contributing code: the plugin reads this file at its top level, before the kernel is constructed, merges the sections and bindings into what it passes down, and the pipelines own `order` decides where they land. Nothing in the plugin knows this packs name. A deployment activates it the same way it activates v5r - by naming it in the active packs list - and a pack that only needs text needs only data.

_shape.sections: [{ name, order, range?, text }] - the pipelines own section shape
_shape.bindings: [{ section, role|phase|member|task, text }] - one dimension selects it
